answer.reason: Two events in the verses happen to the southern country itself: Joshua's conquest and the Amalekite invasion.

clauses.english: was struck by Joshua, who left none remaining
clauses.quote: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south
the Amalekites had invaded the south

doubts: Most marked verses use 'south' only as a direction or boundary (e.g. PSA 126:4, ISA 21:1, EZK 20:46) and were left out.
Some verses may refer to the south of Judah in general rather than the Negev specifically.
